# Lingadevaru HP (Thoshan) — Personal knowledge wiki

> A personal portfolio and knowledge wiki by Lingadevaru H P (Thoshan), covering public projects, articles, news, and learning notes.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://lingadevaru.in/): Portfolio and featured public work.
- [Wiki home](https://lingadevaru.in/wiki/home): Browse the knowledge wiki.
- [Articles](https://lingadevaru.in/wiki/articles): Browse published articles.
- [Projects](https://lingadevaru.in/projects): Explore public projects.
- [Achievements](https://lingadevaru.in/achievements): View milestones and achievements.
- [News](https://lingadevaru.in/news): Read project and site updates.
